org.any-shape.supportStatus: Universal mission is explicit; implementation support and technical schemas remain separately evaluated.

name: Any-Shape purpose
nonGoals: Literal portability in every language without evidence
Browser resizing as the entire mission
Opaque mandatory vendor, telemetry or hosted service
priorities: accessible human presentation and first-class agent affordances

provenance.sourceReference: User instruction in this task and owner-authored CODEX_HANDOFF_002_UNIVERSAL_IDENTITY.md section 1 at 0feb784

purpose: The form may change; meaning, essential functions and trustworthiness must remain.
Human and agent faces must not diverge in domain meaning, validation or authorization.
statement: Any-Shape enables information and operations to remain comprehensible, accessible, attractive where practical, and functionally available to humans AND programmatic agents even as the medium, geometry, constraints, input methods, and computational resources change.
supportedEnvironments: Browser, desktop, text, structured agent and 3D/editor realizations are allowed; only declared and tested scopes are supported.
